_comment_maxWorkers: Every e2e suite talks to the same Postgres, so running them in parallel wins nothing and costs correctness: the workers compete for CPU and connections, a beforeAll that normally takes 3s overruns, and every test in that file fails on a hook timeout. Serially the whole run is also about twice as fast.
_comment_testTimeout: Jest defaults to 5s, which covers a request but not booting AppModule and creating fixtures. CI machines are slower than ours, so this is the margin for that rather than a target to grow into.
